searchText: Hello, does anyone know is there any JS version implementation for blob-utils? I think <@792822129019584562> had some way to send blobs and i'd wager it was in JS I haven't tested this on the most recent devnets but we do have this - https://github.com/ethereumjs/ethereumjs-monorepo/blob/master/packages/client/test/sim/txGenerator.ts that was originally based on the `blob_utils` code <@792822129019584562> is this what you still use? Quick additional note: there is a `4844.md` file in the same directly with some instructions on usage. this was working as last tested on devnet - 7 : https://github.com/ethereumjs/ethereumjs-monorepo/blob/master/packages/client/test/sim/4844devnet5.spec.ts (might need to match chainId for whatever network is being tested) this has instructions to use it: https://github.com/ethereumjs/ethereumjs-monorepo/blob/master/packages/client/test/sim/4844-devnet-5.md this is the actual helper to build blob tx: https://github.com/ethereumjs/ethereumjs-monorepo/blob/master/packages/client/test/sim/simutils.ts#L351 seems to be similar vode in txgenerator, may be we should consolidate
